score_leaders.name: Score Leaders
score_leaders.description: Top picks by composite quality score (system WR + R:R + confidence + freshness)

proven_only.name: Proven Only
proven_only.description: Only trade from systems with WR >= 50% and >= 10 closed picks

momentum_riders.name: Momentum Riders
momentum_riders.description: Chase 24h momentum — highest unrealized PnL from active systems

contrarian.name: Contrarian
contrarian.description: Trade against the crowd — SHORT when consensus is LONG-heavy, and vice versa

regime_aligned.name: Regime Aligned
regime_aligned.description: Only enter trades that match the detected market regime (LONG in bull, SHORT in bear)

high_conviction.name: High Conviction
high_conviction.description: Confidence >= 0.80 AND from systems with WR >= 40% AND R:R >= 1.5

rr_kings.name: R:R Kings
rr_kings.description: Only enter trades with reward:risk >= 2.5 regardless of system

consensus_plays.name: Consensus Plays
consensus_plays.description: Highest system agreement count — many systems agree on direction

fresh_signals.name: Fresh Signals
fresh_signals.description: Only picks < 4 hours old from systems with WR >= 35%

sector_rotation.name: Sector Rotation
sector_rotation.description: Diversified: max 3 crypto, 2 equity, 1 forex — balanced exposure

anti_meme.name: Anti-Meme
anti_meme.description: Everything except meme coins — avoid DOGE, SHIB, PEPE, WIF, BONK etc.

claude_best.name: Claude's Best
claude_best.description: Hybrid: proven system + regime match + R:R >= 1.5 + no conflicts + no memes

prop_conservative.name: Prop: Conservative
prop_conservative.description: Prop firm challenge — $100K sim, 4% daily loss limit, 8% max drawdown, profit target 8%

prop_aggressive.name: Prop: Aggressive
prop_aggressive.description: Prop firm challenge — $100K sim, 6% daily loss limit, 10% max DD, target 10%

prop_swing.name: Prop: Swing Trader
prop_swing.description: Prop firm challenge — $200K sim, 5% daily loss limit, 10% max DD, longer holds, target 8%

deep_drawdown_dca.name: Deep Drawdown DCA
deep_drawdown_dca.description: Buy assets down >25% from 90d high — DCA into deep pain, TP at 50% recovery

rsi_capitulation.name: RSI Capitulation Sniper
rsi_capitulation.description: Buy RSI<35 oversold assets showing bounce confirmation — catch the reversal

fear_greed_contrarian.name: Fear & Greed Contrarian
fear_greed_contrarian.description: Accumulate top-10 crypto when F&G index <= 25 (extreme fear) — be greedy when others fearful

relative_strength_recovery.name: Relative Strength Recovery
relative_strength_recovery.description: Buy the weakest 30d performers once they start bouncing — mean reversion on relative laggards

hoffman_elite.name: Hoffman Elite Combo
hoffman_elite.description: Rob Hoffman's IRB + Connors RSI(2) + Volume confirmation — 78.9% backtest WR, 3:1 R:R ATR stops

htf_trend_follow.name: HTF Trend Follower
htf_trend_follow.description: Higher timeframes always win — only trade when weekly AND daily trend align

htf_weekly_momentum.name: HTF Weekly Momentum
htf_weekly_momentum.description: EMA 9>21>50 daily stack — buy pullbacks to EMA 9 in confirmed uptrend

stocks_best.name: Stocks: Best Picks
stocks_best.description: EQUITY ONLY. Filters all picks to asset_class=EQUITY (AAPL, MSFT, SPY, QQQ, COIN, MSTR, etc). Top scored equity picks from any system. Prices via Yahoo Finance failover.

stocks_short_term.name: Stocks: Short-Term Reversal
stocks_short_term.description: EQUITY ONLY. Same equity filter as Stocks Best, but prioritizes freshest signals (< 12h old). Mean reversion and short-term momentum plays on stocks/ETFs.

forex_carry.name: Forex: Carry & Momentum
forex_carry.description: FOREX ONLY. Filters to asset_class=FOREX (EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDJPY, AUDUSD). Top scored forex picks. Prices via CurrencyLayer/Yahoo. Longer update interval (2h) since forex moves slower.

multi_asset_diversified.name: Multi-Asset: Diversified
multi_asset_diversified.description: STOCKS + FOREX combined. Filters to asset_class in (EQUITY, FOREX). Sector rotation across non-crypto: max 3 equity + max 2 forex. Best diversification outside crypto.

beaten_majors.name: Beaten Majors Long-Only
beaten_majors.description: INTERNAL ENGINE: Inspired by chrspecifics_upwardpotentLONGT TradingView approach. Buy top-10 majors when RSI(14)<40 AND price >10% below 30d high. Long-only, wide stops (-12%), conservative TP (+8%). Simple thesis: buy oversold blue-chips, hold for recovery.

futures_index.name: Futures: Index & Commodities
futures_index.description: FUTURES ONLY. ES, NQ, YM, CL, GC, SI, ZN. Connors RSI-2 (proven 75.7% WR) + EMA stack + Bollinger mean reversion. Trades index futures with tight risk management.

etf_rotation.name: ETFs: Sector Rotation
etf_rotation.description: ETF ONLY. SPY, QQQ, XLK, XLF, XLE, GLD, TLT, IWM. Sector rotation via EMA stack + VIX reversal. Moderate hold periods (5-15 days).

all_asset_tournament.name: Tournament: All Assets
all_asset_tournament.description: ALL non-crypto asset classes combined. Futures + Stocks + Forex + ETFs. Best picks across the board, tournament-ranked by score. This is the prediction tournament portfolio.

regime_filtered.name: Regime Filtered
regime_filtered.description: Only picks where strategy matches current regime (regime_meta_router alignment). Tests if regime filtering improves WR by 5-10pp.

high_consensus.name: High Consensus
high_consensus.description: Only picks where 3+ diverse systems agree. Historical 78.6% WR. Tests consensus as quality filter.

golden_only.name: Golden Only
golden_only.description: Only picks from walk-forward validated strategies (Keltner BTC 66.1% WR, RSI confluence). Tests proven-only approach.

small_position.name: Small Position
small_position.description: Score Leaders picks but with 2% position size (Mercury recommends max 2%). Tests if smaller positions reduce DD.

sentiment_divergence.name: Sentiment Divergence
sentiment_divergence.description: Only sentiment-price divergence signals. Tests new strategy in isolation.

basis_carry_only.name: Basis & Carry
basis_carry_only.description: Funding rate arbitrage + cross-exchange basis carry. Structural edge, market-neutral. Expected Sharpe 2.0+.
